wins: Completed broad TCP/UDP surface discovery within first 10 minutes using masscan (ep001_step07)
Pinned down vulnerable service versions via targeted nmap scripting and recorded banners for follow-up (ep001_step12)
Captured initial foothold credentials from exposed web portal login using automated Hydra run (ep001_step18)
fails: Failed to escalate privileges after foothold because Windows service token lacked admin rights (ep001_step22)
Could not achieve persistence; lateral movement attempts blocked by disabled SMB shares (ep001_step27)
Mission abort: awareness timer triggered before data exfiltration could begin (ep001_step30)
key_outcomes.summary: Recon and initial foothold tactics generated useful intelligence, but the campaign stalled at privilege escalation and persistence phases, leaving the main objective incomplete.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts consistently failed due to missing elevated service accounts and no sudo privileges

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80/443 shows HTTP service with version string containing 'Apache' or 'nginx'
skill_cards.then_action: Run dirbuster + gobuster, and save host-specific web root paths

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is open with default banner
skill_cards.then_action: Use nmap --script sshv1,ssh-auth-methods,ssh-hostkey to enumerate authentication methods

skill_cards.if_condition: When credentials captured from web login
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt lateral login via winrm/rdesktop and record response status codes

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in discovering valuable web endpoints that fed into subsequent credential capture

next_experiments.title: Automate privilege escalation chain
next_experiments.description: Run Windows local privilege escalation scripts (e.g., WinPEAS, Sherlock) immediately after foothold to capture potential misconfigurations before the timer hits 30 minutes

next_experiments.title: Persistence via scheduled tasks
next_experiments.description: After obtaining creds, deploy a scheduled task payload and verify execution to maintain access beyond the awareness timer

next_experiments.title: SMB share enumeration sweep
next_experiments.description: Use smbclient and CrackMapExec to discover writable shares and gather data for lateral movement before session timeout
